records.title: MEGA FOOD PARKS OPERATIONAL IN TAMIL NADU
details:
The MFP sanctioned to Tamil Nadu State Agricultural Marketing Board 
at Tirunelveli district, Tamil Nadu, is an on-going project with 5.9 LMT per annum of 
processing and preservation capacity and 5700 employments opportunities after 
operationalization. 
The details of the MFP and APCs 
approved under PMKSY in Tamil Nadu along with their status of implementation are placed at 
Annexure.

records.title: CLAIM SETTLEMENT UNDER PMFBY
details:
it has been requested to submit the revised DPR in compliance with Cauvery 
Water Disputes Tribunal (CWDT) award and observations made by CWC, incorporating all the 
necessary updated details/drawings etc. as per CWC guidelines for submission, appraisal and 
acceptance of Irrigation and Multi-purpose projects, 2017.
